# commit committer identity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:commitCommitterIdentity`](gmeow-commitCommitterIdentity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commitCommitterIdentity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The recorded committer identity of a commit — the raw historical bytes. Distinct from [`gmeow:committedBy`](gmeow-committedBy.md), which points to the canonical agent currently understood to have committed the changes.
